decisions.reason: The MS 284 weekdays and session time slots do not change the independently specified start and end dates; the dates are already represented by their own same-message MODIFY.
The MS 284 session schedule does not alter the allocated budget; the $31,500 budget is already represented by its own same-message MODIFY.
The MS 284 session schedule does not change the signature requirement or placement; the extension of that requirement to MS 284 is already represented by its own same-message scope MODIFY.
